```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
```


```{r coherence_3D_full, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(WaveletComp)
library(openxlsx)
library(rgl)
library(lubridate)

# --- Load data ---
filnam <- "C:/docu/25_論文/hyogo/lead_coin_lag.xlsx"
x00 <- read.xlsx(filnam, sheet = "index", colNames = TRUE)
tmx <- seq(as.Date("1994-01-01"), by = "month", length.out = length(x00$X1))
df0 <- data.frame(date = tmx, lead = x00$lead, coin = x00$coin)

```


```{r 2d, echo=FALSE}
# --- Wavelet coherency analysis ---
sink("nul")
WC <- analyze.coherency(
  df0,
  my.pair = c("lead", "coin"),
  loess.span = 0.02,
  dt = 1,
  dj = 1/20,
  window.size.t = 5,
  window.size.s = 1,
  lowerPeriod = 2,
  upperPeriod = 64,
  make.pval = TRUE,
  n.sim = 100
)
sink()


# --- 改良版の描画 ---
n_label<-"(CI_先行指数 vs CI_一致指数)"
wc.image(
  WC,
  which.image = "wc",
  color.key = "interval",
  n.levels = 200,
#  color.palette = "hcl.colors(n.levels, 'RdYlBu', rev=TRUE)",
  plot.coi = TRUE,
  plot.contour = TRUE,
  siglvl.contour = 0.1,
  plot.arrow = TRUE,
  col.arrow = "black",        # ✅ 矢印の色（arrow.col ではない）
  use.sAngle = TRUE,          # ✅ 矢印を平滑化
  exponent = 0.7,
  legend.params = list(
    lab = "Wavelet Coherence",
    lab.line = 3.5,
    width = 1.2,
    shrink = 0.9
  ),
  show.date = TRUE,
  date.format = "%Y",
  timelab = "calendar date",
  periodlab = "period (months)",
  main = paste("コヒーレンス スペクトラム",n_label),
  lwd = 2
)
```

```{r 3d, echo=FALSE}

# --- Prepare axes and matrix ---
library(rgl)
library(WaveletComp)

# --- データ準備 ---
coh_mat  <- WC$Coherence
periods  <- WC$Period
time_vec <- as.numeric(format(tmx, "%Y")) + (as.numeric(format(tmx, "%m")) - 1) / 12

# --- メッシュ生成 ---
x_mat <- matrix(rep(time_vec, each = length(periods)), nrow = length(periods))
y_mat <- matrix(rep(periods, times = length(time_vec)), nrow = length(periods))
z_mat <- coh_mat

# --- カラーマップ設定（wc.image と同じ） ---
n.levels <- 200
col_fun  <- colorRampPalette(hcl.colors(n.levels, "RdYlBu", rev = TRUE))
cols <- col_fun(n.levels)
z_norm <- (z_mat - min(z_mat, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(z_mat, na.rm = TRUE) - min(z_mat, na.rm = TRUE))
col_index <- pmin(pmax(floor(z_norm * (n.levels - 1)) + 1, 1), n.levels)
col_surface <- cols[col_index]

# --- 3D描画 ---
open3d()
bg3d("white")

surface3d(
  x = x_mat,
  y = y_mat,
  z = z_mat * 100,
  color = col_surface,
  back = "fill",
  specular = "black",
  ambient = "white",
  lit = FALSE
)

# --- 軸タイトル ---
title3d(
  xlab = "Time (Year)",
  ylab = "Period (months)",
  zlab = "Coherence",
  line = 2,
  main = paste("Hyogo CI;lead-coin;Wavelet PowerSpectrum")
   )

# --- X軸を1995年から5年ごとに設定 ---
year_ticks <- seq(1995, 2025, by = 5)
rgl::axis3d('x', at = year_ticks, labels = as.character(year_ticks), cex = 0.9, lwd = 1.5)

# --- その他の軸設定 ---
axes3d(edges = c("y--", "z--"))

# --- 見やすい比率と視点 ---
aspect3d(8, 6, 6)
view3d(theta = 0, phi = -45, zoom = 1)
# --- Optionally save ---
 library(htmlwidgets)
 rglwidget() %>% saveWidget("coherence_3D_full.html")
iname0<-"lead-coin"
flnam3=paste("C:/docu/25_論文/hyogo/",iname0,"_coh3d.html")
# そのままHTMLファイルに保存
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  rglwidget(),                               # 現在のrglシーンをHTML化
  file = flnam3,  # 保存先
  selfcontained = TRUE                       # 必要なjs/CSSを同梱
)



```
